name: KEMONO SCHOOL DAYS
source:
Sho Karasuma, a boy who transferred to a high school attended exclusively by beastmen.

He had a secret that no one could ever know.

—He was the only “human” at this school!

Wearing ears and a tail, he spent his high school days pretending to be someone else...

If his true identity were revealed, his peaceful daily life would end in an instant.

…Or so he thought—but on his very first day as a transfer student, a beast girl named Rikos figured out who he really was!?

Your choices can either deepen your bond with her or, with a single moment of carelessness, lead to the worst possible outcome!

A school life as gentle as a spring breeze, and a relationship balanced on thin ice.

Where everyday life and thrills intersect, a cross-species romance visual novel!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4997090/KEMONO_SCHOOL_DAYS/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
乌丸翔是一名转入全员皆为兽人的高中的少年。

他怀揣着一个绝不能让任何人知晓的秘密。

——他是这所学校里唯一的“人类”！

戴上兽耳与尾巴，他假扮成兽人的模样度过高中时光……

一旦真实身份败露，平静的日常生活便会在顷刻间灰飞烟灭。

……他原本是这么以为的——谁知就在转学第一天，名叫莉可丝的兽人少女竟看穿了他的真实身份！？

你的每一次抉择既能加深与她之间的羁绊，也可能因一时的疏忽大意而招致最糟糕的结局！

如春风般和煦的校园生活，与如履薄冰的微妙关系。

日常与心跳刺激交织的跨种族恋爱视觉小说！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4997090/KEMONO_SCHOOL_DAYS/]Steam[/url]]
